messages:
maria: starting deploy window now for runtime v2.3.1, console v1.8.0, router v4.2.0. checking cross-service handshake before we unpin traffic.
ops-shepherd: thumbs up. we have a 60m window, rolling canary + 20% ramp planned. @ryan you ok with the router header split change?
ryan: quick checklist — router schema change is backward-compatible but header key name changes KV eviction behavior. recommend hold on full ramp until runtime cache TTLs are validated.
alice: noted. runtime patch invalidates prefix cache for hot routes. if we go >10% canary we may see higher tail latency while caches warm.
deploy-bot: deploy wave started: canary group alpha deployed to us-east-1
```
deploy-bot: wave_id=wf-2026-04-03-17
services: runtime:v2.3.1, console:v1.8.0, router:v4.2.0
status: canary(10%) -> ok on infra checks
```
sre-oncall: seeing a small bump in 5xx from runtime on canary hosts, not huge but noticeable. rolling back would be immediate if 5xx > 1% sustained over 2m.
maria: what's the exact rollback criteria we agreed in the runbook? I want to post it in the release notes.
ops-shepherd: runbook excerpt: 1) sustained 5xx >1% for 2m OR 2) p95 latency increase >400ms for 5m OR 3) console errors for tool-calls >0.5% for 3m -> trigger rollback.
ryan: can we pin console to v1.7.9 for the remaining traffic while router/runtime finish a gradual warm? that avoids console-tool-call schema mismatch.
alice: pinning console is fine, but console v1.7.9 lacks new telemetry flags. ops-shepherd, can deploy-bot perform a partial pin (console pinned, others continue ramp)?
deploy-bot: partial pin command executed:
```
deploy-bot> pin service=console version=1.7.9 scope=global ttl=3600
result: success
```
sre-oncall: after pin, 5xx dropped back to baseline on canary nodes. monitoring p95 closely.
maria: ok — plan: hold full ramp for now. continue incremental ramping for runtime+router, console pinned for 1h. update release notes with: "console pinned to 1.7.9 to avoid early telemetry regression; runtime/router gradual ramping; rollback criteria as per runbook." anyone object?
ryan: no objection. please add note for oncall about cache-priming job to run after 30m if p95 still elevated.
alice: adding small cache-priming job to rollout tasks. will post command in #eng-sre if needed.
ops-shepherd: i'm going to notify product and list the pinned console in CHANGELOG-REL-2026-04-03.
maria: thanks team — holding ramp, will update thread when we hit next checkpoint (T+30m). :white_check_mark:
